summary: This sheet includes architectural plans and details for toilet room layouts, ADA requirements, and accessory installations. It provides specific dimensions and notes likely related to accessibility compliance.

published.title: Inadequate detail reference for door compliance
published.observation: Note states 'ALL DOORS W/ ACCESSIBLE HANDLES AND CLOSURE TO BE ADJUSTED TO MEET MAX 5# PUSH/PULL PRESSURE. SWEEP PERIOD FROM 70 DEGREES TO A POINT 3" FROM LATCH MUST BE AT LEAST 3 SECONDS.' but does not specify the adjustment mechanism or method to verify compliance.
published.drawing_evidence: Note in Toilet Room Plan and General Notes.
published.drawing_location: Adjacent to door symbols and General Notes section in both highlighted plan and detail views.
published.recommendation: Provide additional clarification or specification on how to achieve the door pressure and sweep period requirements.
